content: Bacitracin, when used topically, is indicated for specific situations such as deep or puncture wounds, injuries caused by animal bites, and serious burns. It is also utilized as a first-aid measure to help prevent infection in minor cuts, scrapes, and burns. For proper dosing and application, the affected area should first be cleaned thoroughly. A small amount of the product, approximately equivalent to the surface area of the tip of a finger, should then be applied directly to the affected area. This can be done one to three times daily. If desired, the treated area may be covered with a sterile bandage. If the condition persists, worsens, or if signs of an allergic reaction such as a rash or other symptoms develop, further medical evaluation is necessary.
